subject: Westside Watch homepage clean rebuild
body: CLEAN_START. Create one fresh Penpot board named 00 — Westside Watch Homepage — CLEAN START. Treat previous homepage boards as archived and do not reuse or copy their layers. Build the homepage from scratch with native editable Penpot layers. Use a restrained masthead and navigation, a strong editorial hero, an integrated 5:8 architectural visual field, a Chinese feature module, fine structural rules, and generous whitespace. Palette: Living Paper #FAF9F5, Ink #252525, First Light Gold #A2872A, Watch Night #102A43. Avoid generic cards, rounded panels, demo swatches, duplicate boards, or placeholder test layouts. Typography intent: Cormorant Garamond for English display and Noto Serif TC for Chinese where available. Export the exact new board as PNG and visually verify it. Return the new board id and child count.
design_brief: Quiet, intelligent, architectural Christian editorial publication at dawn. Strong hierarchy, asymmetry, disciplined 5:8 proportions, fine rules, generous whitespace, and a stone-paper-light feeling.
